facts.text: Both CLI and server paths via a shared retrieval layer.
facts.question: Which analysis paths should get retrieval-augmented chunking?
facts.rationale: They share the same analysis prompts and should produce consistent results.

facts.question: What should drive the chunking boundaries?
facts.rationale:
Preserves conversational semantics. Parent max 4000 chars, child max 512 chars, delimiters 

, 
, ., ?, !, ,.

facts.text: Each chunk carries phase, significance, why_context, and related_to metadata.
facts.question: How should chunks be annotated?
facts.rationale: Chunks need analytical context, not just structural boundaries.

details.phase: decision | debug | exploration | planning | execution | review

facts.text: At ingest time, immediately when messages are ingested/synced.
facts.question: When should conversation chunks get embedded?
facts.rationale: Chunks are persistent for cross-session trend analysis, not ephemeral.

facts.text: Option C: Annotated chunks + dynamic query (analysis instructions + session summary + related past insights).
facts.question: What drives the retrieval query?
facts.rationale: Query adapts per session, resists shortcut learning, prevents duplicate coverage.

facts.text: Threshold-based: above ~80% of model context window.
facts.question: When should retrieval kick in?
facts.rationale: Short conversations get full fidelity, long ones get retrieval.

facts.text: Hybrid B+C: window augmentation (compact summary + position tag) + neighbor inclusion (±1 adjacent chunks).
facts.question: How should retrieved chunks be augmented?
facts.rationale: Position tags provide global orientation, neighbors preserve local flow. Deduplication controls token cost.

facts.text: Separate pass with sampled summary (existing pattern). Facets stay output-only.
facts.question: How should facets work with retrieval?
facts.rationale: Facets are holistic, can't be chunked. Not used as retrieval context.

facts.text: Soft gate: compute embeddings in parallel, analysis waits only if not ready by LLM call time.
facts.question: What happens when embeddings aren't ready?
facts.rationale: No blocking for short sessions, analysis quality depends on retrieval.

facts.question: What if embeddings are unavailable?
facts.rationale: Analysis quality depends on retrieval, so waiting is preferable to silent failure.

facts.text: New table vec_analysis_chunks, separate from vec_messages.
facts.question: Reuse vec_messages or create new table?
facts.rationale: Analysis chunks are structurally different (annotated, role-grouped, parent/child). Clean separation avoids schema drift.
